_instructions: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your email details. For Gmail, enable IMAP in Settings → See All Settings → Forwarding and POP/IMAP → Enable IMAP. Then create an App Password at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords (you need 2FA enabled).

protected_senders.description: Emails from these senders will NEVER be deleted or unsubscribed.

routing.description: Add your folder routing rules here. Format: 'sender@domain' or '*@domain' → 'Folder/Path'
